title: Separable Nonnegative Matrix Factorization Using Powered Ratio-of-Norms Regularization
summary: Separable nonnegative matrix factorization (SNMF) has been widely used for low-rank representation and clustering of nonnegative data, owing to its ability to produce part-based and interpretable decompositions. In particular, SNMF is closely related to graph clustering and community detection. To enhance sparsity and identifiability of the learned factors, we propose an $\ell_1^p/\ell_2$-regularized SNMF model based on a powered ratio-of-norms regularizer.
